items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: And then this Ira Glasgow, he went on to sing in that Deluxe Melody Boys Band.

ctx.x: Outdo the other, yeah. And then at the end they would all get together, and some particular step that they could all do together, they would do that, you know.
And at the same time they, my brothers and my cousins, they'd sing in quartets. And then this Ira Glasgow, he went on to sing in that Deluxe Melody Boys Band.
Well, now, where did they operate?
